ZYZqvxFB.description: May be fired once at every model in range, in every facing.

54Y7cxVy.name: Inversion Beam
54Y7cxVy.description: Use the target’s tough value when rolling to hit, and the target’s evasion value when rolling to block.

5mj1MXsq.name: Alchemical Crew
5mj1MXsq.description: When this ship takes the final point of damage that would destory it, roll one die. On a 4+ that point of damage is ignored.

aFNNqS5m.name: Vulture
aFNNqS5m.description: Whenever this ship rams an enemy ship and destroys it, it takes no ram damage and may remove 1 damage.

aH8_vTuR.name: Pirate Royalty
aH8_vTuR.description: Enemy ships with only one non-disabled upgrades count as destroyed for the purpose of morale tests.

cYPQW-xC.name: Erosion Missiles
cYPQW-xC.description: Instead of rolling to block, models must roll as many dice as points of damage it would take to destroy them, and for each roll of 1 they take 1 damage.

d6U45t9x.name: Violent Whisper
d6U45t9x.description: When activated pick one enemy ship within 12“, which must make a boarding marker roll as if it had just been activated.

fG0Y6KZm.name: Shard Cannons
fG0Y6KZm.description: If the target rolls a 1 to block, then it takes +1 damage.

iGI9jyYr.name: Razor Shield
iGI9jyYr.description: This ship removes boarding markers on rolls of 3+, and this upgrade takes 3 damage to be disabled.

J1-kDxAJ.name: Soul Syphon
J1-kDxAJ.description: May be fired once at every model in range, in every facing.

jWGaypKu.name: Wormhole Door
jWGaypKu.description: When activated, place a boarding marker on an enemy ship within 12“.

kEpxuHwc.name: Raid Master
kEpxuHwc.description: Whenever an enemy ship with boarding markers on it is destroyed within 12“, you may place those markers on another enemy ship within 12“ of it.

MhKNdlyY.name: Phantom Bombs
MhKNdlyY.description: Ships must take a morale test per hit, instead of rolling to block, For each failed test, they take 1 damage.

Qrv74-3L.name: Specter
Qrv74-3L.description: Enemies may not shoot at this ship until it shoots for the first time, takes damage, or carries an objective.

RUBSBhtD.name: Carving Lances
RUBSBhtD.description: Gets +2 strength when targeting enemies with disabled upgrades.

sLG8uC5q.name: Raiding Barge
sLG8uC5q.description: At any point during this squadron’s activation, you may place a boarding marker on a ship within 2”.

tc_Hbi6e.name: Predatory Instict
tc_Hbi6e.description: This ship may activate during the phase directly before its type’s phase, instead of activating during its type’s phase.

utdfPquo.name: Fury Inhibitor
utdfPquo.description: Enemy ships within 6“ that activate with this ship in their rear facing, get -2 to their boarding marker rolls.

w-o8Hr7o.name: Star Gills
w-o8Hr7o.description: When this ship overlaps enemy squadrons, they take 1 damage each.

xSxY1svo.name: Shadow Walker
xSxY1svo.description: Whenver this ship overlaps an enemy ship, place a boarding marker on the enemy ship, instead of dealing damage.

YNQ0I_4A.name: Jump Scare Drive
YNQ0I_4A.description: After ramming, place this ship back in the same position in which it started its activation.

yVWFcmI7.name: Ex-Nihilo
yVWFcmI7.description: May choose not to be deployed at the start of the game, but instead may be deployed at the start of any round after the first in the rear facing of an enemy ship, within 6“ of it, and not in the front facing of other enemy ships.

2fzR-FXl.name: Striker
2fzR-FXl.description: Turret gets +1 strength until the end of the round if the squadron activated whilst not engaged.

4c1d2ByB.name: Spatial Superposition
4c1d2ByB.description: When this upgrade is disabled, you may place this ship anywhere within 6”.

B_t2tFjZ.name: Gravity Pulse
B_t2tFjZ.description: Once per activation, pick one ship within 8“, and push that ship D6+1“ directly away.

D1nLkmJ5.name: False Sun Keeper
D1nLkmJ5.description: At the start of each round, you may unleash the false sun, and this ship counts as the only solar wind marker on the battlefield until the end of the round.

GPcUTl77.name: Wind Reader
GPcUTl77.description: After deployment, place a solar wind marker anywhere in contact with the rear edge of the enemy deployment zone.

grKNLqwj.name: Regenerative Skin
grKNLqwj.description: This upgrade takes 3 damage to be disabled. At the end of this ship’s activation, if this upgrade is damaged but not disabled, remove a point of damage from it.

h-Wi1Y4n.name: Drift
h-Wi1Y4n.description: When taking move actions, this ship may make a drift move instead of moving normally. First, move the ship sideways by up to its move speed, then pivot it to face any solar wind marker.

IzytkYjK.name: Stream Missile
IzytkYjK.description: Gets as many Att as upgrades on the target.

k-ey1gEj.name: Gravity Hook
k-ey1gEj.description: Pivot the target by up to 45° per damage from this weapon.

Kd-32itU.name: Mirth
Kd-32itU.description: At the end of its activation, this ship may move 3“ backwards.

kQncAvWu.name: Falconer
kQncAvWu.description: Gets +1 to hit for each facing of the target that has a friendly unengaged squadron within 2".

l-u3QcFT.name: Reaper
l-u3QcFT.description: Gets +1 to hit when shooting targets from its front facing into their side or rear facing.

mKlqgZoS.name: Companion Vanes
mKlqgZoS.description: Whenever this ship makes a drift move, any friendly squadron it passes within 6” of may be placed within 2” of its final position.

MkmE89zT.name: Wraith Frame
MkmE89zT.description: Takes 3 damage to be destroyed. Remove 1 damage from this squadron at the end of each activation.

ncqdVjhk.name: Distortion Lance
ncqdVjhk.description: If this weapon inflicts damage, push the target 3“ in any direction.

OAT8ahpx.name: Warp Gate
OAT8ahpx.description: This ship may only get the spatial superposition upgrade. When a model with less upgrades than this ship would overlap it, place that ship within 3“ of any other ship with the warp gate rule instead.

q_Iw7ttL.name: Destructor
q_Iw7ttL.description: This weapon deals +2 damage per unblocked hit, If you roll a 1 to hit, then this ship takes 2 damage.

rCjqMhaw.name: Perfection Drive
rCjqMhaw.description: Gets +4“ on move and +6“ on cruise/ram actions as long as this ship has not taken any damage.

u4XPKcbF.name: Phase Components
u4XPKcbF.description: This ship may activate during the phase directly before the phase it would normally activate in.

XAdWA9AM.name: Phantasm
XAdWA9AM.description: When deploying this ship, you may deploy an identical copy of it at the same time. The first time one of them interacts with models, objectives or the battlefield, remove the other copy.

yJx7U08J.name: Ring Master
yJx7U08J.description: This ship may make dirft moves when taking cruise actions, moving by up to its cruise value.

118xv4c-.name: Arc Tongue
118xv4c-.description: May only target the closest enemy model.

6NJZ-f_z.name: Event Horizon
6NJZ-f_z.description: Once per activation, may take a morale test. If passed, pick up to 2 ships within 12“ and move them 6“ directly towards this ship.

b4s3CgFj.name: Quad Beam
b4s3CgFj.description: This weapon may be fired at four different targets at once.

b80d8fPr.name: Tyrant Vessel
b80d8fPr.description: When activated, turret gets +1 strength if it was not fired during this ship’s last activation.

DeuCgP40.name: Spirit Shaman
DeuCgP40.description: When activated, may take a morale test. If passed, pick a friendly sqaudron within 2“ and immediately activate it.

EJf9Ofog.name: Spirit
EJf9Ofog.description: At the end of its activation, if this squadron is not engaged, you may place it within 2“ of a friendly ship with Vassal within 18“.

fDwn1aW6.name: Wrath Spines
fDwn1aW6.description: When activated, may take a morale test. If passed, its turret gets +2 attacks until the end of the round. If failed the turrent can’t fire this round.

g0HzibWM.name: Divine Frog
g0HzibWM.description: Once per activation, place 2 new Piranha, Jaguar or Serpent Squadrons fully within 2“ of this ship.

iUh9diqt.name: Psi-Shock
iUh9diqt.description: Must pass a morale test in order to fire this weapon.

lXatSHsI.name: Shell Shield
lXatSHsI.description: Enemies get -1 to hit when targeting this ship in a facing in which it doesn’t have a mounted weapon.

mWR4KgLj.name: Tempest Portal
mWR4KgLj.description: Must pass a morale test in order to fire this weapon.

Ood2Ii6S.name: God Talon
Ood2Ii6S.description: Must pass a morale test in order to fire this weapon.

Ow7Xq9rg.name: Toxin Battery
Ow7Xq9rg.description: Whenever a model is destroyed by this weapon, all models within 4“ take 2 hits with Str 2.

QjTwygnt.name: Shell Prow
QjTwygnt.description: Enemy attacks from the front facing get -1 Str (to a min. of Str 0). This ship's turret can't be fired in the front facing.

r0t38Nga.name: Defense Claw
r0t38Nga.description: When activated, may immediately fire its turret at a squadron within 2“ (may still fire its turret again after moving).

RmAqh_4c.name: Vassal
RmAqh_4c.description: When taking morale tests, may count as having as many non-disabled upgrades as another friendly ship with Vassal within 18“.

sj4BcX_l.name: Invade
sj4BcX_l.description: May use ram actions, but is immediately destroyed when doing so. Instead of comparing upgrades, place 3 boarding markers on the target.

sSAsDRlI.name: Star Drive
sSAsDRlI.description: When activated, may take a morale test. If passed, instead of moving normally, place this ship anywhere within its cruise speed in the same facing, not overlapping any models.

ts5scvfs.name: Grand Spine
ts5scvfs.description: Turret gets Twin-Fire but may only be fired from the sides facing.

uWv4qeX4.name: Primal Bellower
uWv4qeX4.description: When activated, pick a friendly sqaudron within 6“ and immediately activate it.

wkpP2ebM.name: Obsidian Flechettes
wkpP2ebM.description: Gets +2 Att when targeting enemies within 12“.

wNzvj1Tf.name: Beast Home
wNzvj1Tf.description: This ship removes boarding markers on rolls of 2+.

yu3u53oA.name: Heart Eater
yu3u53oA.description: Whenever an enemy ship is destroyed within 18“, remove 1 damage from this ship.

098iwlua.name: Anti-Impact System
098iwlua.description: When ramming or being rammed, instead of either ship taking damage, they are both pushed X*3“ directly away from each other, where X is the number of damage they would have taken.

4q1pT1MN.name: Eraser Beam
4q1pT1MN.description: Gets -2 to hit, This weapon deals +3 damage per unblocked hit.

7R6khT5e.name: Manufacturer
7R6khT5e.description: When activated, place a scrap marker on this ship.

9PTM8kx_.name: Graviton Crusher
9PTM8kx_.description: This weapon deals damage on successful tough rolls, instead of fails.

aAkd0Cz3.name: Processor
aAkd0Cz3.description: Whenever this model disables an enemy upgrade or destroys an enemy squadron, you may deploy a new Process Squadron within 2“.

BtRMppth.name: Space Splitter
BtRMppth.description: When activated, pick a ship within 8“ and swap position with it, in the same facing as the swapped ship.

crAWPJpA.name: Electro Cultist
crAWPJpA.description: When activated, turret gets +1 strength if it was not fired during this ship’s last activation.

E1b3cDVh.name: Tech Convent
E1b3cDVh.description: When activated, turret gets +1 attack, +1 strength or Twin-Fire until the end of its activation (pick one).

F5-6Ue0N.name: Machine Pontifex
F5-6Ue0N.description: Friendly ships within 12“ may remove scrap markers from this ship as if they were on them.

fw-9BJ-T.name: Capacity Banks
fw-9BJ-T.description: May not mount weapons in its front facing. Turret gets +1 attack when firing in the front facing.

GwF8Ry6V.name: Consumption Drive
GwF8Ry6V.description: May remove scrap markers to move +X”, where X is the number of removed markers.

hr43-yVB.name: Overclocked
hr43-yVB.description: Once per round, at the end of its activation, may disable an upgrade to take a cruise action.

kRNB7ARx.name: Repair Arms
kRNB7ARx.description: At the end of its activation, remove 1 damage from this ship and all friendly squadrons that were within 2“ of it during its movement.

lonVyexV.name: Program Crux
lonVyexV.description: When activated, pick a friendly squadron within 6" and immediately activate it.

nq-tWA8m.name: Gun Hijacker
nq-tWA8m.description: Gets +X attacks, where X is the number of weapons on the target.

OPYRGU-x.name: Ruin Cannon
OPYRGU-x.description: May remove scrap markers to get +X attacks, where X is the number of removed markers.

otpAMMxR.name: Data Lord
otpAMMxR.description: This ship always hits on 2+ when targeting enemy ships that have other friendly ships within 12“ of them in all 4 facings.

TjCxfdhU.name: Scrapper
TjCxfdhU.description: Whenever the upgrade of another ship within 6“ is disabled, or a squadron within 6“ is destroyed, place a scrap marker on the closest friendly ship with this rule. Ships may remove scrap markers from themselves to give enemies -X strength when shooting at them, where X is the number of removed markers.

WFkkPf2g.name: Aggressive Recycler
WFkkPf2g.description: This ship may remove 2 scrap markers from itself to use one of its rules that has an effect when activated twice in a row.
